summary: OpenAI published a report describing how students, teachers and families are using ChatGPT for continuous learning outside the classroom, citing usage statistics on education-related conversations.

mechanisms.reason: The report cites large, specific weekly message volumes for education-related ChatGPT usage, indicating sustained high-volume inference demand in that vertical.
mechanisms.quote: In the U.S., prompts related to classwork and homework peak at more than 460 million messages per week during the school year and climb on Sunday evenings.
